Owen (People Ops): Quick update on commuter support for the upcoming SF onsite week (Jun 21-25). Due to temporary shuttle reroutes and limited parking, were launching a 1-week "last-mile" travel stipend pilot to help cover parking, rideshares, or transit passes for people who need to get to the office. Details below.
Maya (Facilities): TL;DR: If you usually take the shuttle but the reroute adds >20m, or if parking is unavailable, you can get reimbursed up to $40/day (max $160 for the week). Eligible costs: validated parking receipts, single-trip rideshares to/from office, and daily transit passes.
Priya (Eng): Does this work for folks commuting from outside SF (e.g., Marin/Oakland ferry + rideshare last leg)?
Owen (People Ops): Yes. Anything that covers the "last mile" to the office is in scope. For multi-leg trips submit receipts for the reimbursed leg (e.g., BART + rideshare receipt).
Jordan (Finance): Expense instructions: use code `POPS-COMM-2026`, tag project "onsite-lastmile". Attach receipt(s) and indicate which day(s) and mode. We will prioritize same-week approvals for Jun 21-25.
Transit Bot: Shuttle reroute details + map: https://rwd.co/shuttle-update (note: temporary stop at 5th & Brannan removed Jun 21-25).
Maya (Facilities): Parking note: the visitor lot adjacent to Building C will be reserved for vendors; public parking is limited. If you have ADA needs or require on-site parking, DM Facilities and well reserve a spot.
Priya (Eng): Are contractors/vendors eligible? I have a contractor who needs help.
Jordan (Finance): This pilot is limited to Redwood W-2 employees only. Contractors and agency employees are not eligible at this time. We'll review expanding in future pilots.
Owen (People Ops): To enroll: fill the short form by Jun 10 -> https://rwd.co/lastmile-form. We have budget for ~80 participants; priority to folks who would otherwise miss critical onsite sessions because of transit/parking constraints.
Priya (Eng): If I carpool with an employee and pay them gas money, is that reimbursable?
Jordan (Finance): Reimbursements for informal carpool contributions are allowed up to $25/day; must include a brief note with the other employee's name and the amount. No cash attestations — use a digital transfer with a receipt or documented expense.
Owen (People Ops): Tax note: under guidance from benefits counsel, small commute reimbursements in this pilot are being treated as non-taxable de minimis benefits; we'll publish a definitive FAQ after enrollment closes.
Maya (Facilities): If you need help finding a rideshare voucher instead of reimbursement, reply here and well prioritize voucher provisioning for high-need cases.
Priya (Eng): Thanks team, submitting the form now.
Owen (People Ops): Will send follow-up email with the policy summary, form link, and an example expense template. Ping @Owen (People Ops) for edge cases.
